## Type of change
<!-- Matches the Conventional Commits type, see CONTRIBUTING.md -->
- [ ] `feat`: new functionality
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` / `perf`: no change in behaviour
- [ ] `test` / `docs` / `build` / `ci` / `chore`
- [ ] Breaking change (`!` in the commit message)

## Checklist
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://github.com/PhilippRosenfeld/OS/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-messages)
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `uv run pytest -q` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Docs updated where needed (README, `man` / `--help` texts)
